trees/01_traversals_recursive_and_iterat.algorithm:
traverse(node, preorder, inorder, postorder):
    if node is empty: return
    add node.val to preorder   (before both children)
    traverse(node.left, ...)
    add node.val to inorder   (between the children)
    traverse(node.right, ...)
    add node.val to postorder   (after both children)
preorder_iterative(root):
    order = empty, stack = [root] if root exists
    while stack is not empty:
        node = pop, add node.val to order
        push node.right if it exists, then node.left   (right first so left pops next)
    return order
inorder_iterative(root):
    order = empty, stack = empty, node = root
    while stack is not empty or node exists:   (a node to walk down from OR one still pending)
        while node exists: push node, node = node.left
        node = pop, add node.val to order
        node = node.right
    return order

trees/02_bfs_level_order_and_height.algorithm:
levels = empty list, queue = [root] if root exists
while queue is not empty:
    level = empty list
    repeat len(queue) times:   (only the nodes present when the level starts)
        node = pop from the front
        add node.val to level
        append node.left and node.right if they exist   (they form the next level)
    add level to levels
return levels
height(root) = number of levels   (empty tree 0, single node 1)

trees/06_serialize_and_deserialize.algorithm:
emit(node, tokens):
    if node is empty: add "#" to tokens, return   (the explicit None makes decoding unambiguous)
    add str(node.val) to tokens
    emit(node.left, tokens)
    emit(node.right, tokens)
serialize(root): tokens = empty, emit(root, tokens), return tokens joined by ","
consume(tokens):
    token = pop from the front   (every call eats from the same queue, in preorder)
    if token == "#": return empty
    node = new node(int(token))
    node.left = consume(tokens)   (the left subtree uses up its tokens first)
    node.right = consume(tokens)
    return node
deserialize(data): tokens = queue of data split on ",", return consume(tokens)

linked_lists/01_build_print_insert_delet.algorithm:
build_list(values):
    dummy = new node, tail = dummy
    for each value: tail.next = new node(value), tail = tail.next
    return dummy.next
list_to_array(head):
    out = empty, node = head
    while node exists: add node.val to out, node = node.next
    return out
insert_at(head, index, val):
    dummy = new node pointing at head, prev = dummy   (index 0 becomes an ordinary case)
    repeat index times: prev = prev.next
    prev.next = new node(val) pointing at prev.next
    return dummy.next
delete_value(head, val):
    dummy = new node pointing at head, prev = dummy
    while prev.next exists and prev.next.val != val: prev = prev.next
    if prev.next exists: prev.next = prev.next.next   (unlink by skipping over the node)
    return dummy.next

linked_lists/02_reverse_iterative_and_re.algorithm:
reverse_iterative(head):
    prev = empty, cur = head
    while cur exists:
        nxt = cur.next   (save the rest BEFORE cutting the link)
        cur.next = prev
        prev = cur, cur = nxt
    return prev
reverse_recursive(head):
    if head is empty or head.next is empty: return head
    new_head = reverse_recursive(head.next)
    head.next.next = head   (the old next node is the tail of the reversed rest)
    head.next = empty
    return new_head

linked_lists/04_detect_cycle_floyd.algorithm:
meeting_point(head):
    slow = head, fast = head
    while fast exists and fast.next exists:
        slow = slow.next, fast = fast.next.next
        if slow is the same node as fast: return slow   (compare nodes, values may repeat)
    return empty
has_cycle(head) = meeting_point(head) is not empty
cycle_start_index(head):
    meet = meeting_point(head)
    if meet is empty: return -1
    pointer = head, index = 0   (restart one pointer at the head, keep the other)
    while pointer is not meet: pointer = pointer.next, meet = meet.next, index += 1
    return index

linked_lists/07_reverse_nodes_in_k_group.algorithm:
dummy = new node pointing at head, group_prev = dummy
loop:
    kth = the node k steps after group_prev
    if kth is empty: return dummy.next   (fewer than k nodes left: leave them)
    group_next = kth.next
    prev = group_next, cur = group_prev.next   (seed prev with the next group)
    while cur is not group_next:
        nxt = cur.next, cur.next = prev, prev = cur, cur = nxt
    old_head = group_prev.next
    group_prev.next = kth   (kth is the reversed group's new head)
    group_prev = old_head   (the old head is now the group's tail)

stacks/01_array_stack_and_queue_via_two_.algorithm:
Stack:
    push(x): append x to items   (the end of the list is the top)
    pop(): remove and return the last item
    peek(): return the last item
    empty(): items has no elements
Queue:
    enqueue(x): inbox.push(x)
    refill():
        if outbox is empty:   (ONLY then, or the order would break)
            while inbox is not empty: outbox.push(inbox.pop())
    dequeue(): refill(), return outbox.pop()
    peek(): refill(), return outbox.peek()
    empty(): inbox is empty and outbox is empty

monotonic_stacks/01_next_greater_element.algorithm:
answer = [-1] * n, stack = empty   (indices; values decreasing bottom -> top)
for i from 0 to n - 1:
    while stack not empty and nums[top] < nums[i]:   (strictly smaller tops are answered)
        j = pop
        answer[j] = nums[i]
    push i
return answer
